title: Customer quote card
brief:
A customer quote card for social media, 1200×675 px, as a PNG.

- Background #ffffff, with a 12px bar of #6d5efc down the whole left edge, and 72px padding inside it.
- Fonts: Inter (regular and bold) and Lora (italic), in fonts/.
- The quote: "We replaced four template systems with one. Our emails, invoices and social cards now ship from the same components." in Lora italic, 44px, #111827, line height 1.4.
- At the bottom of the card, a row: the customer's photo, assets/avatar-daniel.png (a 256×256 file), shown 72×72 and round; beside it, stacked, "Daniel Okafor" (Inter bold, 28px, #111827) and "Head of Platform, Northwind" (Inter regular, 24px, #6b7280); and at the right end of the row, the Orbit logo, assets/orbit-logo.png (a 252×128 file), shown 100px wide.

texts.text: We replaced four template systems with one. Our emails, invoices and social cards now ship from the same components.
